display.title: A Set Number of Words: Shemiras Halashon, Part 2
display.summary_short: Each person is given a set number of words for a lifetime, so do not waste them; words of Torah, prayer and brachos are never deducted and even add years to our life.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, based on the teachings of the Chofetz Chaim about shemiras halashon, being careful never to say anything evil. Uncle Yossi explains that, as our Sages teach, every person is allotted a set number of words for a whole lifetime, and each word spoken is deducted from that amount, so it would be foolish to waste this precious gift on empty or silly talk. Words of prayer, brachos and Torah study work the opposite way: they are not deducted at all, and Hashem adds more words, and more years of life, so that we have time to say them. This is what we say in the evening prayers: the words of Torah 'are our life and the length of our days'.
display.lesson: Don't waste words on nonsense; fill your speech with Torah, prayer and brachos, which add years to life.
